Hey,

I have few thoughts.

posts.name: lynkfox
posts.cooked:
3) No, there is no way to change the google sorting. Time will change it, eventually. I did setup sotm.wikidot.com to only be a page that links to the new wiki.

 

2) Cauldron on CCGDrive thru is linked on the Fan Created page, but because this has become the Official Sentinel Comics Wiki, not the Sentinels of the Multiverse, that probably won't happen, unless Christopher et all decide they want to do that. Probably not, as they are approved, but not official content. The wiki is not for the card game anymore, but for the lore of the Sentinel Comics universe, and Cauldron isn't part of that. (actually, if you look on the Cauldron stuff, they were asked not to use the SentinelComics logo that is used on Hero Cards (right above health) and instead use their own, Action Comics logo. (A stylized A) - another reason why they probably wont ever been on the Sentinel Comics Wiki.

By the by, if someone wanted to set up their own wiki for Cauldron stuff, I would have no issue with helping that get started (even though I don't have or have ever used any of those cards, but they look interesting) and even linking to it.

 

1) Fan art - I'm... a bit warry about that. Mostly because of space. It can become really problematic really fast and cause a lot of bandwidth and hosting space issues quickly. If GtG wants to support that then we can certainly set it up, but that is in their pocket book now, not mine :P For the time being the Fan Created page links to the fan art thread here on the forums, which is acceptable I believe.

 

The exception is jagarcia's stuff, but thats cause it is in use on all the pages already.

 

good thoughts though!

posts.name: lynkfox
posts.cooked:
Deleted 1777 spam accounts that had been cluttering up the system.

 

Unfortunately, in the process, one or two valid accounts might have been caught in the swing. This would be because the script used looks for accounts that have 0 edits.

 

If you've ever made an account on the Wiki and did not make any edits to any pages, your account has been removed from the database. Sorry!

 

When you make a new account, simply edit your user page (by clicking on your user name in the upper right hand corner, adding some things to the edit box, and saving the page) and that will do the trick, if you don't have some other edit you're doing already.

 

Next major project. Localization for different languages.

After the Chrono-Ranger episode, I was thinking about how the Timeline wiki page should have a way for us to indicate how sure we are that events are in the right order. So I invented a new column headed "Anchor," and we put a mark in that column when we are certain that two events are in the right place relative to each other.

So far this page really includes Naturalist through Chrono-Ranger stuff, because I haven't gone back to listen to all the previous Letters Pages - fun as that might be. I'd welcome additional contributions!
